blurb: King Slayer Sportfishing is Niagara's premier sportfishing charter! We offer guided Salmon and Trout fishing trips on Lake Ontario and the Niagara River all year. We specialize in chasing King Salmon, Lake Ontario's hardest fighting fish! We operate a multi-boat fleet.
